title: rc-physics-twin road edge
description: One road edge: a centreline with elevation and banking, a width, surface stretches and speed breakers. World frame ISO 8855 (x, y in the ground plane, z up), SI units, angles in radians. Arc length s is horizontal (measured in the x-y plane) along the centreline from its first point; the first and last segments extend straight beyond the ends. Off the road (|lateral offset| > width / 2) is not modelled: the ground query fails there.

id.description: Edge id, as the fleet sim's RoadGraph names it.

width.description: Drivable width [m], centred on the centreline.

centreline.description: Polyline points in travel order. Consecutive points must not coincide.

bank.description: Banking [rad], positive when the road rises to the LEFT of travel. Linear between points.

surfaces.description: Stretches of road whose grip differs from the tyre data's reference surface (mu_scale 1). Later entries win where stretches overlap.

s.description: Arc length of the breaker's centre [m].

profile.description: round_hump: height * sin^2(pi u / length), u from the leading edge.
